items.name: Open Graphics Power Preferences (Windows Settings)
items.description: Launches per-app GPU preference panel from the Power Management section.

items.name: Overlay/Graphics Power Report (/qh excerpt)
items.description: Exports graphics/display related settings from SCHEME_CURRENT for manual review.

steps.command: $ts=Get-Date -Format "yyyyMMdd-HHmmss"; $f=Join-Path (Join-Path $PWD "logs") ("graphics-power-"+$ts+".txt"); powercfg /qh SCHEME_CURRENT SUB_VIDEO | Out-File -Encoding utf8 $f; Write-Output "Saved: $f"
